top_signals.title: Thames Water Seeks to Buy Time as MPs Push for Nationalization
top_signals.summary: Thames Water is pressing on with plans to restructure its massive financial load, even as pressure mounts on the UK government to temporarily nationalize the beleaguered utility.

top_signals.summary: Swiss sportswear brand On has pulled off a marketing coup by luring Real Madrid and France striker Kylian Mbappe from Nike to launch its football products.
